title: Flamenco Pop
tagline: Flamenco's vocal and rhythmic language meeting contemporary popular song.
summary: Flamenco pop blends elements of flamenco singing, guitar, and rhythm with pop arrangements and production. Artists have brought the style into mainstream recordings while drawing on Spain's rich regional traditions. The sound can range from acoustic and intimate to electronic and dance-oriented, with flamenco expression remaining an important reference.

pillars.name: Manolo Escobar
pillars.why: Escobar brought popular Spanish song and flamenco-associated styles to a broad audience through film and recordings.

pillars.name: Lola Flores
pillars.why: Flores was a charismatic singer and performer whose work connected flamenco expression with popular entertainment.

pillars.name: Camarón de la Isla
pillars.why: Camarón's collaborations and recordings expanded flamenco's reach and influenced later popular interpretations.
